state.instructions: Go to the shop, find a red t-shirt, select size medium, and get the price. Never add anything to the bag and never open the checkout. Stop once the price of a red t-shirt in size medium has been read.

itemVisible.instructions: Is the item that `instructions` ask for visible in `state.screen`, as a picture or a name (not as a menu entry or a heading)?

menuOpen.instructions: Is a list of links shown under the row of menu entries at the top of `state.screen`?

optionChosen.instructions: Is every option that `instructions` ask for (such as the size) chosen in `state.screen`?

valueVisible.instructions: Is the price of the item that `instructions` ask for visible in `state.screen`, next to that item?

criteria.home: The front page of a web site: banners and a few sections of items
criteria.list: A list or grid of several items, with a price or a name under each
criteria.item: The page of one single item: a large picture, options such as sizes, and a price
criteria.other: Anything else: a pop-up, a bag, a checkout, an error
